source_snapshot.items: AC Power Cycle System Sequence Check
source_snapshot.procedure: Capture baseline, shut down to S5, turn mapped smart-PDU ports off, wait for full drain, restore AC, issue protected power-on, run Post-Boot Stress/Basic Health/dmesg/RAS and repeat 100 cycles.
source_snapshot.criteria: 100 recommended cycles with no boot failure, lock, MCE/kernel error, health mismatch or Post-Boot Stress failure.
source_snapshot.bundle: No bundle; sixty attended and 2880 machine minutes.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO because AC mains switching is physical/human-only; agent only collects post-restore evidence.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY/CRITICAL; trained operator owns mapped PDU switching and drain confirmation, with complete per-cycle reconciliation.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Correctly prohibits agent physical AC switching but lacks PDU mapping/drain and full cycle evidence controls.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains MANUAL ONLY and adds operator, PDU event, drain, boot, health and recovery evidence.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-07/08 preserve evidence; ED-11/12 gate physical power/retry; ED-36/38 govern identity, logs and verdict.

original_test_intent: Have a trained operator repeatedly remove and restore AC mains through the correct smart-PDU ports, allowing full discharge, and prove every restore boots cleanly with unchanged health, passing stress and no new RAS/kernel fault.
original_method: Map all SUT PSU feeds to PDU ports, approve cycle count/off/drain/on timing and safety, preserve baseline, then for every operator-controlled AC transition reconcile PDU events, drain confirmation and boot ID, collect complete Basic Health/Post-Boot/RAS/system evidence and stop on first incomplete or abnormal cycle.
manual_activity: A trained operator switches and records mapped PDU AC ports and drain for every cycle; the agent only collects post-restore evidence; the owner decides the verdict.
required_inputs: Trained operator and approved AC control
Cycle count, boot readiness and boot media
safety_requirements: Require operator, maintenance and verified recovery
Switch every approved feed and honor drain interval
Preserve full per-cycle logs and PDU history
Stop on abnormal PDU/PSU, incomplete drain, boot/health/RAS failure
Never continue or retry failed cycles
agent_execution_scope: Observe/reconcile operator PDU events, drain and boot IDs
Perform no AC toggle, timing invention, recovery or DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve port/feed map, drain proof, cycle contract and safety controls
Authorize physical work and recovery thresholds
Disposition any failed/incomplete cycle and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The manual boundary is correct; execution also requires exact PDU/PSU mapping, drain evidence and complete cycle health records.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Operator performs mapped PDU AC off/drain/on; protected automation observes events and collects post-restore evidence only.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: BIOS boot media, Basic Health, S5, PDU off/drain/on, protected power-on, Post-Boot Stress, dmesg/RAS, 100 cycles, no bundle and 60/2880-minute values remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind each PDU port event and drain interval to a unique boot and complete health/stress/RAS result.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Clarifies operator/safety boundaries and evidence integrity without reducing source coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Unmapped feeds or premature restore may leave standby power and invalidate an AC-cycle claim.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Repeated mains interruption can affect PSU/hardware safety, data integrity and recoverability.

project_override_considerations: If redundant PSUs span feeds, all intended feeds must be mapped and switched according to the approved sequence; a single-port event cannot stand in for full AC removal.
expected_evidence: Owner/operator approval, PDU/PSU map, drain/cycle/readiness/recovery contract
Baseline boot media and health/stress/RAS/system state
Per-cycle operator/PDU port state, AC off/drain/on timestamps and unique boot ID
Final reconciliation, no-clear/no-secret/no-retry audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source leaves PDU-to-PSU mapping, full-drain proof and mandatory cycle count undefined, asks to clear logs and shows plaintext IPMI credentials. These gaps prevent safe automated execution despite a valid manual intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review is complete; execution remains manual-only pending an approved operator, feed map, drain/cycle contract and recovery.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2069 Wistron-AMD SVM-00023-V002: approve every PSU-feed-to-smart-PDU-port mapping, AC-off/full-drain/AC-on timing and proof, mandatory cycle count, boot/readiness and health/RAS acceptance, trained-operator safety stops, console/OOB recovery and evidence contract.

review_improvement: Keeps the correct manual classification while making electrical isolation, discharge and cycle evidence auditable.
independent_technical_reasoning: AC cycling is valid only if every relevant PSU feed is removed long enough to satisfy the approved discharge condition. PDU command success alone does not establish rail state, and premature restore changes coverage and risk. Because mains control is physical and safety-critical, an agent may observe but not own the action. The first anomaly ends the sequence so it cannot be obscured by later cycles.
